paite: Huan Ahab in Elijah thilhih tengteng, namsau a zawlnei tengteng athah thute toh Jezebel ahilh hi.
heading: Sinai Tang Ah Elijah
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

paite: Huchi in Jezebel in Elijah kiang ah, "Huai mite lak a mi khat hinna bang a zingchiang a hichi hun ma a na hinna ka hon bawlsak sam keileh pathiante'n alohloh uh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng,” chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

paite: Huchi in huai atheih in alau a, athou a, ahinna humbit ding in atai hi. Judah gam a Beer-sheba khua ava tung a, huai ah asikha anusia hi.
english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

paite: Amah gamdai ah ni khat lampaina tan ah ahoh a, Juniper sing nuai ah tu in sih angenta hi. "Ahunta; TOUPA aw, tu in ka hinna la in, ka pute sang in lah ka hoihzaw tuan kei," achi hi.
english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

paite: Juniper sing nuai ah alum a, a-ihmuta hi. Ngai in, angel in ahong khoih a, akiang ah, "Thou inla ne in," achi hi.
english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

paite: Ama'n a-en vialvial a, ngai in, alu chin ah tanghou pei, suangsa a haiminsa leh tuithawl ana om hi. Huchi in hiaite ne in adawn a, alum nawn hi.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

paite: Anihveina ding in TOUPA angel ahong pai nawn a, ahong khoih a, "Thou inla, ne in, na paina ding agamla lo lai hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, ne in adawn a, an ziak a hatna in Pathian tang Horeb tan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli apai hi.
english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

paite: Huai a kokhuk khat ava tung a, huai ah a-omta hi. Ngai in, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a, akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua; a-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

paite: Ama'n, "Pawtkhia inla, huai tang ah TOUPA ma ah va dingh in," achi hi. Ngai in, TOUPA ahong pai a, huihpi hat mahmah in tangte TOUPA ma ah amutkhang a, suangpi akitam phuakphuak hi. Himahleh huai ah TOUPA a-om kei. Huih nun khit in zin ahong ling a; himahleh huai zinling ah TOUPA a-om kei.
english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.

paite: Zinlin khit in meikuang ahong pawt a; himahleh huai mei ah TOUPA a-om kei. Meikuang nung in aw ngat ngiingei ahong pawt hi.
english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in huai azak in apuanin amai akhuh a, va pawtkhia in kokhuk lutna ah ava dingh hi. Ngai in, huai aw in akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua. A-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, gamdai lam a Damaskas ah pai in. Na tun chiang in Siria kumpipa ding in Hazael thau na nilh ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

paite: Israel kumpipa ding in Nimshi tapa Jehu thau na nilh ding; na sik a zawlnei ding in Abel-meholah a mi Shaphat tapa Elisha leng thau na nilh ding ahi.
english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Hazael namsau pel peuhmah Jehu in athat dia; Jehu namsau pel peuhmah Elisha in athat ding.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

paite: Himahleh Israel gam ah Baal ma a khukdin ngei lou leh amah tawp ngeiloumi sangsagih kei a ding in ka sit hi," achi hi.
english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

paite: Huchi in huai a pan apawtkhia a, Shaphat tapa Elisha ava mukhia hi. Ama'n langkawn bat bawngtal tuak sawm-le-nih in lou ana kai hi. Asawm-le-nihna azang hi. Elijah in ava naih a, apuan ava silhsak hi.
heading: Elisha Sapna
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

paite: Ama'n abawngtalte paisan in Elijah anungdelh a, "Ka nu leh ka pa hon tawpsak ding in ka hon ngen, huchi in ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Pai nawn ve le, bang ka hon chih a eita?" achi hi.
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

paite: Amah zui lai akik nawn a, bawng tuakkhat agou a, bawng vante in asa ahuan a, mite apia a, amau ane uhi. Huchi in athou a, Elijah adelh a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.
